// Graceful degradation: no Active watchlist rows surfaces all active agents for baseline seeding.
let LookbackPeriod = 14d;
let ApprovedAgents = materialize(
    _GetWatchlist("AIGS_ApprovedAgents")
    | where Status =~ "Active"
    | project
        WL_AgentId = tolower(tostring(AgentId)),
        WL_AgentName = tostring(AgentName),
        WL_BaselineVersion = tostring(BaselineVersion),
        WL_ExpectedPlatform = tostring(Platform),
        WL_RequiredGuardrailType = tostring(RequiredGuardrailType),
        WL_BaselineOwner = tostring(BaselineOwner)
);
let WatchlistDeployed = toscalar(
    ApprovedAgents
    | summarize Count = count()
    | project Count > 0
);
AgentsInfo
| where Timestamp >= ago(LookbackPeriod)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by AgentId
| where LifecycleStatus =~ "Active"
| extend NormalizedAgentId = tolower(tostring(AgentId))
| join kind=leftouter (ApprovedAgents)
    on $left.NormalizedAgentId == $right.WL_AgentId
| extend
    InBaseline = isnotempty(WL_AgentId),
    VersionDrift = isnotempty(WL_BaselineVersion)
        and tolower(Version) != tolower(WL_BaselineVersion),
    PlatformDrift = isnotempty(WL_ExpectedPlatform)
        and tolower(Platform) != tolower(WL_ExpectedPlatform)
| extend DriftStatus = case(
    not(WatchlistDeployed),
        "INFO - Watchlist has no Active rows; seed the baseline from this inventory",
    not(InBaseline),
        "FLAG - Active agent is not in the approved baseline",
    VersionDrift and PlatformDrift,
        "FLAG - Version and platform differ from the approved baseline",
    VersionDrift,
        "FLAG - Version differs from the approved baseline",
    PlatformDrift,
        "FLAG - Platform differs from the approved baseline",
    "IN-BASELINE - No version or platform drift detected"
)
| where not(WatchlistDeployed) or not(InBaseline) or VersionDrift or PlatformDrift
| project
    Timestamp,
    DriftStatus,
    AgentId,
    AgentName,
    Platform,
    Version,
    WL_BaselineVersion,
    WL_ExpectedPlatform,
    LifecycleStatus,
    PublishedStatus,
    Guardrails,
    Permissions,
    Owners,
    EntraAgentId,
    SourceAgentId,
    CreatedDateTime,
    LastUpdatedDateTime,
    WL_RequiredGuardrailType,
    WL_BaselineOwner
| order by Timestamp desc
